title: Municipality and barangay codes unique per project

entries.summary: Removes global UNIQUE on municipalities.code and barangays.code; uniqueness enforced per project in application layer.
Validate name/code (municipality) and code (barangay) scoped to municipality_projects.project_id so different projects may reuse the same codes.
CLI test: same code 001 on two projects passes; duplicate within one project fails.
